title: Affected-test-first validation using the deterministic import graph
observation: EXP-0002 (EVR-0007): the import-graph selector finds 98% of affected test modules at zero model cost and selects ~14 of 46 modules. The full suite takes ~11 minutes and runs on every orchestrated node that uses the project validation command.
evidence: Acceptance: selected-tests step runs before the full validators and is reported separately (affected-tests evidence); completion/integration still require the full validators; offline replay of EVS-TEST-SELECTION reports subset share 36% mean with no hidden failures (full suite still runs). Default retries-only per EVR-0011.
suggested_direction: For intermediate nodes, run the import-graph-selected test modules first and fail fast on them; always run the full declared validators before integration/completion, so no gate is weakened. Measure validation wall time and missed-failure rate on real runs; consider a trace-map cache with import-graph fallback.
acceptance: Selected-tests step runs before the full validators and is reported separately
